aboutText: At Finmat Joinery, we provide honest advice, careful workmanship and a smooth process from first chat to final install. Proudly serving Thomastown and Melbourne's north, we treat your home like our own and focus on quality that lasts. Our local, hands-on team designs and builds bespoke cabinetry for kitchens, bedrooms, bathrooms, and laundries, ensuring every piece is built for real everyday living.
servicesText: We design and install custom cabinetry throughout Thomastown, focusing on quality that’s built to last. From initial concepts to careful installation, we handle every step with clear communication and local expertise.
